title: Kusho ukuthini u-A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 no-C2?
invitation: Lawa makhodi ezinga abonakala ezincwadini, ezifundweni, ezivivinyweni, kuma-app nasezinhlelweni zolimi emhlabeni wonke. Lapha sichaza ukuthi asho ukuthini ngempela, kungani amakhono akho engaba sezingeni elihlukene, nokuthi i-Gef iwasebenzisa kanjani.
summary: I-Gef isebenzisa i-CEFR A1–C2 njengemephu ehlanganyelwayo yekhono lolimi, igcine i-Pre-A1 yezinyathelo zokuqala, bese yengeza ngaphezu kwe-C2 ukukhetha kwayo ‘Ukukhuluma ngokugcwele / Izinga lesikhulumi somdabu’. Ikhono lakho langempela lingahluka ekufundeni, ekulaleleni, ekukhulumeni, ekubhaleni, ekusebenzisaneni nasekudluliseni incazelo.

blocks.title: Imephu ehlanganyelwayo yekhono lolimi
blocks.text: Amazinga A1 kuya C2 avela ku-Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, noma i-CEFR. Inikeza abafundi, othisha, izikole, izivivinyo nabashicileli indlela efanayo yokukhuluma ngekhono lolimi. U-A no-B akuwona amamaki esikole, futhi i-Gef ayicabangi ukuthi zonke izilimi zinendlela efanayo yamagama noma uhlelo lolimi.

blocks.title: Pre-A1 · Izinyathelo zokuqala
blocks.text: I-Pre-A1 yisigaba esingaphambi kwe-A1. Ungase wazi amagama ambalwa, izimpawu, imisindo, amagama abantu, izinombolo noma imisho oyibambe ngekhanda kodwa usadinga ukwesekwa okuningi. Izinto zanamuhla ze-CEFR zifaka i-Pre-A1. Esikalini esilula se-Gef, indawo ephakathi isho ulwazi olungu-zero, kanti isinyathelo sokuqala ngaphandle yi-A1.

blocks.title: A1 · Oqalayo
blocks.text: Ku-A1 ungakwazi ukwenza izinto eziwusizo ngolimi oluncane ezimweni ozijwayele nezicacile. Ungaqonda izinto ezimfishane nezilula futhi ushintshisane ngolwazi oluyisisekelo. Ukuya ku-A2 kusho ukuncika kancane emishweni ebambe ngekhanda nokuphatha izimo eziningi zansuku zonke ngokwakho.

blocks.title: A2 · Nsuku zonke
blocks.text: Ku-A2 impilo yansuku zonke iqala ukuphathwa kahle ngolimi: abantu, izindawo, umsebenzi noma isikole, ukuthenga, ukuhamba, isikhathi nezidingo ezisheshayo. Ukuya ku-B1 kusho ukuxhumanisa imibono ezingxenyeni ezinde, ukuchaza izizathu ezilula nokuphatha izimo ezingabikezeleki kalula.

blocks.title: B1 · Ozimele
blocks.text: Ku-B1 ungaphatha izimo eziningi ezijwayelekile ngaphandle kokuhlela wonke umusho kusengaphambili. Ungalandela incazelo eyinhloko yolimi olucacile nolude futhi ukhulume ngokuxhumene ngokuhlangenwe nakho, izinhlelo, okuthandayo, imibono nezinkinga. I-B2 idinga ububanzi, imininingwane, isivinini nokulawula okwengeziwe.

blocks.title: B2 · Ukuzimela okuqinile
blocks.text: Ku-B2 ungabamba iqhaza ngokuphumelelayo ekuxhumaneni okude, uxoxe ngemibono ephathekayo nengaqondakali, futhi usebenze ezimweni eziningi zomphakathi, zemfundo nezomsebenzi. Ukuya ku-C1 kudinga ukulawula okucashile kokucabangela, ama-nuance, register, ukuhleleka nesitayela.

blocks.title: C1 · Othuthukile
blocks.text: Ku-C1 ulimi luba ithuluzi eliguquguqukayo. Ungaphatha izinto ezinzima, uqonde okungashiwo ngokuqondile, futhi uvumelanise ithoni nesitayela nesimo. Ukuya ku-C2 kumayelana nokujula, umehluko omncane, ukubeka kabusha ngokushesha, imikhakha ekhethekile nokulawula okunembile kunohlu lokugcina lohlelo lolimi.

blocks.title: C2 · Ikhono eliphezulu kakhulu
blocks.text: I-C2 yizinga eliphezulu kakhulu elijwayelekile lokubhekisela le-CEFR. Umsebenzisi we-C2 angaphatha ulimi olunzima kakhulu ngokulawula kahle incazelo, ukwakheka, okushiwo ngaphansi nesitayela. I-C2 ayisho ukwazi wonke amagama, ukungalenzi iphutha, noma ukuba yisikhulumi somdabu ngokuzenzakalelayo.

blocks.title: Ukukhuluma ngokugcwele / Izinga lesikhulumi somdabu · Ukuzichaza okuphezulu kwe-Gef
blocks.text: I-Gef yengeza ngaphezu kwe-C2 ukukhetha kwayo Ukukhuluma ngokugcwele / Izinga lesikhulumi somdabu. Lokhu akuyona i-CEFR C3 noma isitifiketi esisemthethweni. Umuntu ongelona isikhulumi somdabu angakukhetha uma ikhono lakhe langempela kulelo khono liqhathaniswa nelomuntu omdala oyisikhulumi somdabu okhuluma ngokugcwele. I-Gef ichaza ikhono, hhayi umsuka.

blocks.title: Ikhono lakho lolimi liyisimo, hhayi uhlamvu olulodwa
blocks.text: Amakhono ayisithupha angahluka: Ukufunda, Ukulalela, Ukukhuluma, Ukubhala, Ukusebenzisana kanye ne-Mediation. Ungaba C1 ekufundeni, B2 ekulaleleni, A2 ekukhulumeni. I-radar graph enama-axis ayisithupha ikhombisa lo mehluko.

blocks.title: Izinga akulona checklist yazo zonke izifundo zangaphambilini
blocks.text: Ukufunda ulimi akukhuli ngokulinganayo. Ungaphuthelwa umthetho wokuqala wohlelo lolimi futhi ube nekhono elithuthukile kwenye indawo. I-Gef isebenzisa izinga ukuchaza iphethini iyonke yalokho ongakwenza; i-B2 ayisho ukuthi zonke izifundo ze-A1 ne-A2 ziphele ngokuphelele.

blocks.title: I-Gef manje ikala Ukufunda, hhayi yonke i-hexagon
blocks.text: I-Gef manje iyi-reading-first app. Ungazibika wonke amakhono ayisithupha, kodwa evidence evela ezincwadini, ezifundweni zokufunda, ekuqondeni nasekusebenziseni isichazamazwi kufanele ithinte kuphela Reading estimate. I-Gef akufanele iqagule Speaking, Listening, Writing, Interaction noma Mediation ngokusekelwe ekufundeni.

blocks.title: Ilebula le-A2 encwadini likhuluma ngencwadi
blocks.text: Uma i-Gef ibeka incwadi ku-A2, lokho kuyisiginali yobunzima bokufunda. Ukuqeda incwadi kuy evidence mayelana nokufunda, kodwa akufakazeli ukuthi wonke amanye amakhono nawo A2. Nasezivivinyweni kufanele kubhekwe ukuthi yini eyakalwa ngempela.

blocks.title: Iyini i-mediation?
blocks.text: I-Mediation iwukusiza incazelo iwele igebe. Ihlanganisa ukuhumusha nokutolika bukhoma, ukufingqa umbhalo onzima, ukuchaza umqondo ngolimi olulula, ukudlulisa ulwazi phakathi kwabantu abangenalo ulimi olufanayo, noma ukubeka kabusha ukungaboni ngaso linye ukuze izinhlangothi zombili ziqonde.

blocks.title: Course progress inganikeza umkhondo owusizo
blocks.text: Amanye ama-app ashicilela ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-course yawo ne-CEFR. Duolingo Score: 0–29 A1, 30–59 A2, 60–99 B1, 100–129 B2, 130–160 C1/C2. Lokhu course progress, hhayi independent test yawo wonke amakhono; i-Gef igcina original score njenge-evidence eyodwa.

blocks.title: Umhlaba unezinhlelo eziningi zamazinga olimi
blocks.text: I-CEFR akuyona yodwa. ACTFL isetshenziswa emfundweni yolimi e-US, ILR 0–5 kwezinye izimo zikahulumeni, CLB/NCLC eCanada, JLPT N5–N1 ngesiJapane, HSK ngeMandarin. Izinhloso zihlukile, ngakho i-Gef ayicabangi perfect one-to-one equivalent.

blocks.title: Isibonelo: JLPT yesiJapane
blocks.text: Kusukela ngoDisemba 2025, umphumela we-JLPT ophumelele ungabonisa official CEFR reference level ngokusekelwe ku-JLPT level ne-total score. Kodwa i-JLPT ikala language knowledge, reading ne-listening; ayikali speaking, writing noma interaction. Mapping kufanele ithinte kuphela amakhono akalwe ngempela.

blocks.title: I-HSK yaseChina iyashintsha, ngakho version ibalulekile
blocks.text: I-HSK yi-standardized Mandarin test. HSK 2.0 inamazinga ayisithupha nobudlelwano bomlando ne-CEFR. HSK 3.0 entsha yakhelwe stages ezintathu namazinga ayisishiyagalolunye, kodwa transition ka-2026 isaqhubeka. I-Gef igcina HSK version futhi ithatha nine-level-to-CEFR conversion njenge-estimate kuze kushicilelwe official concordance.

blocks.title: Framework ayifani ne-test
blocks.text: I-CEFR yi-framework yokuchaza proficiency. Izivivinyo nezinhlangano zingakwazi uku-align results nazo. Score idinga context: amakhono akalwe, ukuthi alignment yenziwa kanjani futhi nini, nokuthi result official noma estimate. Gef estimate akufanele ivezwe njenge-official CEFR certificate.

blocks.title: Ayikho universal A2 word count eyodwa
blocks.text: Vocabulary ibalulekile, kodwa i-CEFR ayichazi A1, A2 noma B1 ngenani elilodwa lamagama. Izilimi ziyahlukahluka ku-word segmentation, writing system, compounds, morphology nokuhlelwa kwencazelo. English vocabulary estimate ayikwazi ukukopishwa ngokuqondile kuzo zonke izilimi.

blocks.title: Indlela i-Gef esebenzisa ngayo levels
blocks.text: I-Gef isebenzisa CEFR A1–C2 njenge-shared coordinates, Pre-A1 yezinyathelo zokuqala, kanye nezinga layo Ukukhuluma ngokugcwele / Izinga lesikhulumi somdabu phezulu. Izincwadi zine-reading difficulty, profile ingagcina skill values ayisithupha. Language-specific curriculum data ichaza concepts, word senses, grammar, scripts ne-text types ngokwehlukana.

blocks.title: Gefstimate yi-estimate, hhayi diploma
blocks.text: Uma i-Gef esikhathini esizayo ihlanganisa repeated evidence, English UI ingabiza estimate ngokuthi Gefstimate. Leyo wordplay ngeke iphoqwe kwezinye izilimi. Yi-evidence-based estimate ye-skill ethile, hhayi official CEFR certificate, futhi i-Gef kufanele ikwazi ukuchaza evidence esetshenzisiwe.

blocks.title: Uya kanjani ku-level elandelayo?
blocks.text: Hhayi ngokugcwalisa magic progress bar eyodwa. Future Gef estimates zingahlanganisa lesson performance, difficulty yezinto ozifunda ngempumelelo, help oyidingayo, comprehension results ne-skill-related evidence. Vocabulary ne-grammar kuyasiza kodwa akuwona umnyango owodwa. Incwadi eyodwa elula akufanele ikukhuphule ngokuzenzakalelayo, nosuku olulodwa olunzima akufanele lukwehlise ngokuzenzakalelayo.

blocks.title: Ngamafuphi
blocks.description: Zero kusho ukuthi ulwazi alukaqali. Pre-A1 yizinyathelo zokuqala. A1 ne-A2 zakha basic everyday ability. B1 ne-B2 zibonisa independence ekhulayo. C1 ne-C2 yi-proficiency ephezulu, eguquguqukayo nenembile. I-Gef yengeza phezulu izinga layo Ukukhuluma ngokugcwele / Izinga lesikhulumi somdabu. Ikhono lakho langempela liyisimo samakhono ayisithupha.
